position_overview:
Title : Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager 

 Full-Time or Part-time : Full-time

 Reports To : Director of Communications 

 Employment Category : Salaried/Exempt
qualifications:
Required Skills/Abilities: 

Must be able to take projects from concept to completion with minimal guidance

Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills a must

Proficiency with Facebook, Twitter, TikTok, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube and other social media channels from a business perspective with an emphasis on ad creation and evaluation

Basic knowledge of Adobe CS (HTML and photo editing) for use in developing web content

Basic video editing skills for social media content

Knowledge of AP style 

Proficiency in Microsoft Office software, including Word, PowerPoint and Excel

Proficiency with Google analytics and Google Ad Grant Management

Attention to detail and fact checking 

Excellent time-management skills as social media monitoring requires time commitments outside of normal business hours to accommodate peak social media traffic on nights and weekends

Ability to coordinate and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

Detail-oriented, creative, deadline-driven team player who can adapt and learn quickly, particularly in regard to new software and technology

Must be able to legally handle firearms 

 Education and Experience: 

Bachelor’s degree communications, marketing or related field

At least 4 years related experience required. 

Hunter safety certification, or pursue the certification upon hiring

 Physical Requirements: 

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times. 

 Remote or Telecomm Status (select one): 

Position can work remotely.

Salary Description

$60,000 Minimum Annual Salary
